name: Default
shortDescription: CalDAV web client with month, week, day and list views for managing personal and shared calendars on an existing CalDAV server.

alerts.message: AgenDAV needs an existing CalDAV server. Set AGENDAV_CALDAV_SERVER to its base URL (for example https://dav.example.com/dav.php/ for Baikal) before logging in; users sign in with their CalDAV credentials. This image authenticates with HTTP Basic, so the CalDAV server must accept it: Baikal defaults to Digest, switch its WebDAV authentication type to Basic.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
